title: MULTI_LLM_RESULT payload
description: The JSON after `MULTI_LLM_RESULT: ` on the last stdout line of every multi_llm.py invocation, built by utils/cli_common.ResultContext.payload and read by the hosts (the instruction core, the opencode plugin's src/index.mjs, the codex MCP server) through cli_common.parse_result_line or their own parser. Six keys are always present; every other key is present only when it applies, and absent never means a default value: an absent `user_next_step` means no answer, never 'workflow complete'. Strict at the top level: this line is produced and read by one plugin version within one invocation, so an unknown key is drift, and tests/test_result_contract.py fails on it. Nested objects stay open, as their writers grow keys additively; the same test requires every key their builders write to be declared. Nothing validates against this schema at run time. Prose contract: docs/development/dispatcher.md, 'Entrypoint and result protocol'.

mode.description: The mode word that ran (`review-plan`, `status`, `util next-command`, ...); null when no mode was resolved.

phase.description: The phase name (modes.py), which can differ from the mode word: review-code runs code-review.

state.description: The exit code's word (cli_common._STATE_BY_EXIT) or one of its overrides: `running`/`died` on a status exit 2 for a run still in flight or whose process is gone, `partial` on an exit 0 with failed model slots.

exit.description: 0 done, 1 unexpected error, 2 nothing to do or not terminal yet, 3 needs a human; 128+signal when a signal ended the run.

artifacts.description: Paths the invocation produced, in recording order, without duplicates.

next.description: The one mechanical follow-up the caller owes (a tool route may run it unasked); null when none is owed. Never an --internal-* flag.

notice.description: Advisory workflow prose a terminal status poll carries (the workflow view's notice, a validation-context sentence). Never `next`.

progress.description: The watched run's `.status.json` progress object, whole and unreworded (status, when one run is selected).

progress_lines.description: That run already rendered: opaque lines a host may print verbatim (the roster, the current-state line, `just finished:`).

error.description: One plain line saying why the run stopped; only beside state `error` or `needs-human`.

ran_from_root.description: The repository root a command typed in a subdirectory ran from (cli_common.RAN_FROM_ROOT_KEY).

user_next_step.description: The workflow's next phase as the command the user types (utils/next_phase.NextPhase.to_dict). Never beside a non-null `next`, never on exit 1 or 3. {phase: null, command: null, complete: true} when no required phase is left.

optional_before.description: Pending optional phases that come before the primary; omitted when empty.

manual_tasks.description: Manual tasks implement deferred that the user still owes.

markdown.description: The step as the report's closing section, ready to copy.

user_resume.description: The command that resumes a stopped write phase, for the user to type (utils/next_phase.emit_resume, set by `util next-command --blocked`). Nothing may run it unasked.

commit_range.description: The commit range a commit front door acts on, for a tool route to render the commit block from (utils/commit_range.result_payload).

commit_fixes.description: The [COMMIT_FIXES] decision of a commit review's apply, read from the saved guard (utils/commit_apply.fix_payload).
